pli-tv-bi-vb-pc48:1.1: tena samayena buddho bhagavā sāvatthiyaṃ viharati jetavane anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc48:1.2: tena kho pana samayena thullanandā bhikkhunī āvasathaṃ anissajjitvā cārikaṃ pakkāmi.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc48:1.3: tena kho pana samayena thullanandāya bhikkhuniyā āvasatho dayhati.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc48:1.9: thullanandā bhikkhunī punadeva taṃ āvasathaṃ paccāgantvā bhikkhuniyo pucchi
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc48:1.13: kathaṃ hi nāma bhikkhuniyo āvasathe dayhamāne bhaṇḍakaṃ na nīharissantīti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc48:1.14: yā tā bhikkhuniyo appicchā …pe… tā ujjhāyanti khīyanti vipācenti
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc48:1.15: kathaṃ hi nāma ayyā thullanandā āvasathaṃ anissajjitvā cārikaṃ pakkamissatīti …pe…
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc48:1.16: saccaṃ kira bhikkhave thullanandā bhikkhunī āvasathaṃ anissajjitvā cārikaṃ pakkamatīti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc48:1.19: hi nāma bhikkhave thullanandā bhikkhunī āvasathaṃ anissajjitvā cārikaṃ pakkamissati
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc48:1.21: evañca pana bhikkhave bhikkhuniyo imaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ uddisantu
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc48:1.22.1: yā pana bhikkhunī āvasathaṃ anissajjitvā cārikaṃ pakkameyya pācittiyanti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc48:2.1.8: bhikkhuniyā vā sikkhamānāya vā sāmaṇeriyā vā anissajjitvā parikkhittassa āvasathassa parikkhepaṃ atikkamantiyā āpatti pācittiyassa.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc48:2.1.9: aparikkhittassa āvasathassa upacāraṃ atikkamantiyā āpatti pācittiyassa.
